name: Secret
description: Hidden facts that are true in the generated fiction

fields.description: A person with the {{ background:official.generator.name }} background secretly reports to {{ faction.name }}.
A concealed chamber lies beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}, and its current purpose is known to only a few people.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is concealing a dangerous institutional failure that has not yet become public.
The genuine revered relic of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} has been secretly replaced; {{ faction.name }} or another unknown group may hold the original.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is being blackmailed over information that has never become public.
Attacks attributed to a creature of the {{ monster.name }} type are being staged by ordinary people for an undisclosed purpose.
A legitimate supply network secretly moves the material known as {{ material.name }} through systematic {{ crime:smuggling.name }}.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background lives under a carefully maintained false identity.
Two people—one with the {{ background.generator.name }} background and the other with the {{ background.generator.name }} background—share an undisclosed family relationship.
{{ faction.name }} maintains a hidden pact with influential followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }}.
The following criminal activity is being concealed to protect the current leadership of a government following the {{ government.name }} model: {{ crime.name }}.
The unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} was never destroyed as publicly claimed and remains hidden in uncertain hands.
Senior members of {{ faction.name }} knowingly protect a network devoted to {{ crime.name }}.
The succession records of a government following the {{ government.name }} model were deliberately altered, though the intended beneficiary remains uncertain.
The leaders of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} removed a genuine teaching from public doctrine and concealed every surviving copy.
A living creature of the {{ monster.name }} type is secretly bound beneath a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is secretly destroying or withholding the material known as {{ material.name }} to manufacture a profitable shortage.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is the unrecognized legal heir to the leadership of a government following the {{ government.name }} model and may not know it.
{{ faction.name }} and {{ faction.name }} secretly coordinate their public hostility to manipulate outsiders.
Maps of the region known as {{ region.name }} are systematically altered to conceal the existence of a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Important memories were magically removed from someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background, who believes the gaps are natural.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model secretly funds the following service on behalf of {{ faction.name }}: {{ service.name }}.
The owner of the building known as {{ building.name }} knowingly shelters people carrying out the following offense: {{ crime.name }}.
The official founding history of {{ faction.name }} was forged to hide its original dependence on a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background who was declared dead is alive and hidden inside a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Two governments, one following the {{ government.name }} model and the other following the {{ government.name }} model, secretly answer to the same unelected council.
The building known as {{ building.name }} is a living being that has begun to awaken and subtly reshape its interior.

The sacred protections maintained by the religion known as {{ religion.name }} at a site described as {{ site.generator.name }} have already failed, but its leaders continue to stage reassuring rites.
Someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background secretly provides the following service to {{ faction.name }} while publicly denying any connection: {{ service.name }}.
An ordinary {{ animal.name }} genuinely manifests {{ rules.name }}, and its keeper conceals the fact to prevent confiscation, worship, or dangerous experimentation.
A feared creature of the {{ monster.name }} type is knowingly employed by a government following the {{ government.name }} model for deniable intimidation, transport, or defense.
The leaders of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} know that a sacred relic is counterfeit, but its miracles are real and arise from a source they cannot explain.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background has been replaced by a duplicate that possesses enough memories to maintain the deception.
{{ faction.name }} secretly feeds, protects, and maintains a dangerous creature of the {{ monster.name }} type in order to contain it, appease it, or use it later.

The creature of the {{ monster.name }} type guarding the place described as {{ site:dungeon.generator.name }} is the active containment keeping something worse from escaping; killing it would break that defense.
The item known as {{ loot.generator.name }} bears no curse: it is aware, has the following personality, and deliberately obstructs an owner it dislikes: {{ personality.description }}
Has several illegitimate children and has lost track of exactly how many, where they live, or which promises were made to their other parents.
Is having an affair with the adult spouse, relative, subordinate, superior, rival, or close friend of someone important to them.
Is simultaneously maintaining several affairs between adults without all participants knowing about one another.
Their adult spouse knows about the affairs, genuinely does not care, and finds outsiders’ assumptions far more irritating than the arrangement.
They and their adult spouse secretly maintain an open relationship or participate in consensual partner-swapping while preserving a conventional public image.
Secretly attends exclusive erotic parties for consenting adults where local nobles, clergy, officials, and wealthy patrons expect absolute discretion.
Secretly enjoys being consensually dominated by trusted adult partners and fears that discovery would ruin their public authority.
Has a particular adult fetish they desperately do not want their family, colleagues, congregation, or social circle discovering.
Has a far more adventurous consensual sex life with other adults than their austere or innocent public reputation suggests.
Regularly visits a brothel catering to adults while publicly condemning prostitution and demanding punishment for its workers.
Secretly works or previously worked as an adult prostitute, courtesan, escort, erotic performer, professional dominant, or similar professional.
Owns an unexpectedly large and carefully cataloged collection of erotic literature, explicit art depicting adults, scandalous correspondence, or intimate curios.
Writes extremely successful erotic fiction about adults under a pseudonym and quietly mines acquaintances’ scandals for inspiration.
Has slept with an adult professional, military, political, or religious rival despite maintaining fierce public hostility.
Does not actually know which of several possible adults is the other parent of their child and has encouraged a convenient assumption.
Is far less sexually experienced than their legendary reputation suggests and has been improvising advice from rumor, bravado, and erotic fiction.
Cannot actually read despite holding a position that clearly requires literacy and relies on memorization, loyal aides, and aggressive confidence.
Bought or falsified their title, qualifications, military record, religious credentials, or heroic reputation.
Is secretly deep in debt because of gambling and has begun diverting obligations, valuables, or entrusted money to stay ahead of creditors.
Faked a divine vision for influence, money, revenge, or status and was alarmed when people began acting on it.
Their celebrated heroic achievement was mostly an accident, misunderstanding, or panicked attempt to escape the danger.
Their impressive scar came from an embarrassingly mundane accident rather than the duel, monster, battle, or assassination attempt they describe.
Secretly relies on a wig, false teeth, padding, lifts, painted features, or another mundane cosmetic deception to maintain their image.
A priest privately does not believe in the religion they publicly serve and treats the role as employment, influence, or family obligation.
A priest knows their deity demonstrably exists but personally dislikes the deity, its demands, and most of its worshippers.

entries.name: Relic is an unidentified body part

fields.description: A supposedly holy relic is an unidentified body part whose species, owner, and connection to the faith have never been established.
A ruler is terrible at governing but exceptionally good at organizing parties, cultivating celebrity, and making every failure briefly enjoyable.
A government position, complete with salary and staff, exists entirely to employ an influential person’s incompetent relative.
A band of adventurers deliberately attracts, breeds, releases, or invents monster problems so frightened communities will pay them to solve the resulting crisis.
An executioner secretly sells ropes, clothing, teeth, final letters, or other souvenirs taken from the condemned and from the place of execution.
Necromancers knowingly use the dead as effectively unpaid labor while officials and employers conceal the practice because it is profitable.
A trusted healer deliberately withholds complete treatment or worsens recoverable conditions so patients remain dependent on expensive continued care.
Has knowingly eaten the flesh of another thinking being, conceals the act carefully, and may intend to do so again.
Accidentally killed someone years ago and knowingly allowed an innocent person to take the blame, punishment, and lasting disgrace.
Used money, rank, intimidation, or institutional influence to suppress credible accusations of persistent unwanted sexual advances toward adults.
The apparently evil organization known as {{ faction.name }} performs disturbing rites because stopping them would remove protection against a greater supernatural threat.
A community of {{ race.name }} officially believed extinct survives inside a sealed, hidden, extradimensional, subterranean, or otherwise inaccessible place.
A celebrated victory was staged, misreported, or fabricated and rewritten into history; surviving evidence contradicts the accepted heroic account.

entries.name: Monster Fed to Hold a Border

fields.description: Locals secretly feed a creature of the {{ monster.name }} type because its territory keeps a worse predator, army, supernatural force, or other threat away.
